description:
📣 Home For Sale! 🏡

Nestled in a prime location in Killeen, the residence at 801 Rowdy Dr offers the perfect blend of comfort and convenience. This 2015-built home features a spacious 2,032 sq.ft layout with 4 bedrooms and 2 full baths, ideal for both relaxation and entertainment.

The kitchen is a chef's delight with its double oven, granite countertops, and decorative mosaic backsplash.

Situated on a premium corner lot, the property also includes solar screens and a storage shed, enhancing both functionality and curb appeal. ✨

With proximity to local schools, shopping, and just an hour's drive from Austin, this home is an exceptional find for anyone seeking a tranquil lifestyle with city amenities within reach. 📚🛒🚗
